picks.game: Boston Red Sox vs Baltimore Orioles
picks.rationale: The Boston Red Sox, despite a recent dip in form, hold a better overall record (75-65) compared to the Baltimore Orioles (69-71). Public betting has consistently favored Boston, with the moneyline moving slightly in their direction, suggesting alignment with sharp money. Red Sox starter Jake Bennett is coming off an impressive performance, having thrown six shutout innings in his last outing. While Baltimore's Brandon Young is a capable pitcher, the Red Sox are well-positioned to secure a victory in this competitive opener.

The Milwaukee Brewers are in strong form, having won six of their last eight games and holding a significant lead in the NL Central. They have demonstrated recent dominance over the Cubs, winning the last two games of this series with high-scoring performances. Brewers' starting pitcher Logan Henderson boasts an excellent 2.48 ERA and has been particularly effective in his recent starts. In contrast, Cubs starter Kevin Gausman carries a higher 4.52 ERA, and the Brewers' bullpen has been stellar while Chicago's relievers have struggled.

picks.game: Miami Marlins vs Kansas City Royals
picks.rationale: The Miami Marlins enter this game on a two-game winning streak against the Royals and have won four of their last five head-to-head matchups. Miami will send their ace, Sandy Alcantara, to the mound, who holds an impressive 13-8 record and a 3.46 ERA this season. Historically, when Alcantara starts and the Marlins are favored, the team has a strong 10-5 record. The Kansas City Royals, conversely, are on a three-game losing streak and are significantly hampered by a lengthy injury list, impacting their overall team strength.

picks.game: St. Louis Cardinals vs Los Angeles Dodgers
picks.rationale: The St. Louis Cardinals have shown surprising strength against the Dodgers recently, winning four of their last five head-to-head matchups, including the last two games of this series. Dodgers' star Shohei Ohtani is reportedly physically compromised and struggling at the plate, which could limit Los Angeles' offensive firepower. The Cardinals have an excellent track record of covering the run line as underdogs, doing so in their last six such games. Conversely, the Dodgers have struggled to cover the run line as home favorites against NL opponents, failing in 13 of their last 15 games.

picks.pick: St. Louis Cardinals vs Los Angeles Dodgers Over 8 (-101)
picks.rationale: The recent head-to-head contests between the Cardinals and Dodgers have been high-scoring affairs, with the last two games finishing 8-6 and 13-8, both easily exceeding the 8-run total. The Cardinals have demonstrated a strong offensive trend on the road, with each of their last seven away games going over the total runs line. Additionally, the Dodgers are coming off an extra-innings loss, and eight of their last nine games following such a loss have also gone over the total. Despite Dodgers starter Tarik Skubal's typically low-scoring starts, the overwhelming recent offensive trends and situational factors point towards a higher-scoring game.

picks.game: Nashville SC @ New York City FC
picks.rationale: Nashville SC enters this match as the league leader, boasting a remarkable 16-4-2 record and a four-match winning streak in MLS play. Their offense is firing on all cylinders, led by Sam Surridge and Hany Mukhtar, who have combined for 23 goals this season. In contrast, New York City FC is struggling, sitting 16th in the table and winless in their last five competitive games. Despite playing on the road, Nashville's superior form and the generous +155 moneyline offer significant value against an NYCFC side that has shown defensive vulnerabilities, conceding 9 goals in their last five matches. Both teams appear to be at full strength with no reported injuries for key players.
